contents.text: Vowels can be short or long. A long vowel says its name. A short vowel does not.

header.text: The letter a is a vowel. When a is followed by just consonants, a does not say its name. It makes a short a sound (/ă/) instead.
When a is followed by a consonant and a silent e, a says its name. It makes a long a sound (/ā/).
When a is followed by another vowel, the two vowels can make a vowel team. In vowel teams that start with a, a says its name. It makes a long a sound. The other vowel is silent.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about stained glass windows.

paragraphs.text: Some of the most beautiful works of art are not paintings. They are windows! Stained glass windows are made up of pieces of colored glass. The pieces are held together with metal, wood, or other materials. As light shines through the glass, the room is filled with colors.

Stained glass is found in buildings all over the world. Some people travel very far to see these amazing works of art. Every year, almost one million visitors come to see the magnificent stained glass in the Sainte-Chapelle, a church in Paris.

There are different kinds of stained glass windows. Some are made to tell stories from long ago. Others are used to honor important heroes or leaders. One of the most popular stained glass designs is the rose window found in many older churches. The rose window is round and made to look like a colorful flower in full bloom.
The colorful light from stained glass windows adds a special kind of beauty to any building.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about marching bands.

title.text: California, Pasadena. 2009 Tournament of the Roses Bandfest. Bands of America Honor Band.

paragraphs.text: Have you ever been to a football game or watched one on TV? If you have, you've probably seen a marching band at the half-time show. Like other bands, marching bands are made up of people playing musical instruments. But marching bands are special because the players make music on the move!
Members of a marching band move in step with each other, and sometimes they even dance as they play. The music and dancing help build the excitement of the crowd watching the band.

The crowd sits higher than the field. This makes the marchers look like lines on paper. When the marchers move in a set path, they create pictures on the field. They can form shapes, words, and even animals.

Making these pictures is not easy. In fact, it requires hours of work! The marchers must carefully plan their movements and practice them over and over. During a show, all the band members must move at exactly the right time. When everyone is in place, the picture appears and the crowd cheers!

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about ikebana.
Ikebana

pieces.text: is the art of putting flowers together in special ways, or flower arranging. Ikebana started in Japan hundreds of years ago. paragraphs.text: Line dancing has been around for thousands of years. It is found in countries around the world—in South Africa, Greece, Brazil, and many other places. Line dancing is exactly what it sounds like—people dancing together in lines.

Different line dances have different moves. Some are fast and some are slow. But most line dances have one thing in common. Dancers in a row move together, following patterns. It is important that dancers stay in step with each other. If they don't, it can throw everyone off.

Country line dancing is popular in the United States today. Dancers move to the lively beat of country and western music. Everyone does the same dance moves in the same direction. Then they turn and repeat the moves in another direction.

You do not have to know how to dance to participate. Just listen to the beat of the music if you want to take part in the fun. Then watch what the other people in the line are doing and follow along with them. Once you learn the moves, you can teach someone else to line dance!

There are different kinds of stained glass windows. Some are made to tell stories from long ago. Others are used to honor important heroes or leaders. One of the most popular stained glass designs is the rose window found in many older churches. The rose window is round and made to look like a colorful flower in full bloom.
The colorful light from stained glass windows adds a special kind of beauty to any building.

paragraphs.text: Can your mouth make a sound like a drum? If it can, then you can beatbox! Beatboxing is a great way to make music without an instrument.

Beatboxers use their mouths to make clicks, pops, and other sounds. But beatboxers are most known for using their lips, tongues, voices, and breath to sound just like drums. You might have heard this type of music on the radio or seen it on TV. But people have been using their voices to imitate drum sounds for thousands of years.

Modern beatboxing started in the 1980s. It was first done by hip-hop musicians in the United States, but soon it spread to all kinds of music around the world. Some countries even hold beatboxing contests.

Beatboxers often form groups and perform together. The world record for the largest beatboxing act was earned by a group of more than six thousand people! But even two people can start a beatbox group. Anyone can do it!
